### Checklist

<!--
Please submit the work in a way where you could honestly say `This is finished`.
-->

- [ ] I consider the submitted work as finished
- [ ] I tested the code for its functionality
- [ ] I wrote test cases for the relevant uses case
- [ ] I added/update the relevant documentation
- [ ] Where necessary I refactored code to improve the overall quality
- [ ] For bug fix -> I implemented a test that covers the bug

For a scenario entry:

- [ ] `scenario-tools validate` passes on the entry
- [ ] The entry holds public content only: no customer data, no internal address, no real credential
- [ ] I ran the scenario on an OpenAEV platform I am allowed to test
